agent_host.description: The host of the agent. This is the same as database host, since the agent must be installed in the same machine as source database.

agent_ora_home.description: The home directory of the Oracle database.

agent_password.description: The agent user's password. It should have a minimum length of 10 characters.

agent_port.description: The port number of the agent.

asm_option.description: Default value: `false`. Set to `true` if you're using ASM on a non-RAC instance.

asm_password.description: ASM password. Mandatory if `use_oracle_rac` or `asm_option` is set to `true`.

asm_user.description: ASM user. Mandatory if `use_oracle_rac` or `asm_option` is set to `true`.

connection_type.description: Possible values:`Directly`, `PrivateLink`, `SshTunnel`. `SshTunnel` is used as a value if this parameter is omitted in the request and any of the following parameter's values is specified: `tunnel_host`, `tunnel_port`, `tunnel_user`. Otherwise, `Directly` is used as a value if the parameter is omitted.

enable_archive_log_only.description: Default value: `false`. Set to `true` if you're using archive log only mode.

enable_tde_encryption.description: Default value: `false`. Set to `true` if you're using TDE encryption.

host.description: DB instance host or IP address.

pdb_name.description: (Multi-tenant databases only) The database's PDB name. Omit this parameter for single-tenant databases.

tde_wallet_password.description: TDE wallet password. Required for password based wallet.

tns.description:
Single-tenant database: The database's SID.
Multi-tenant database: The database's TNS.

tunnel_host.description: SSH host, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel (do not use a load balancer).

tunnel_port.description: SSH port, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.

tunnel_user.description: SSH user, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.

update_method.description: The method used to detect new or changed rows. Supported values: - `LOGMINER` - Fivetran uses LogMiner, a utility that is part of Oracle Database, to detect modified rows in the source tables. - `TELEPORT` - Fivetran's proprietary replication method that uses compressed snapshots to detect and apply changes.

use_oracle_rac.description: Default value: `false`. Set to `true` if you're using a RAC instance.

use_pdb_only.description: Default value: `false`. Set to `true` to connect directly to a single PDB. When `true`, set `database` to the PDB name and omit the `pdbName` field. Use only for Direct or Archive Log Only capture. Not supported with TDE, ASM, or RAC.

password.description: ESM key for the user's password.

user.description: ESM key for the user name.
